column1: # Spanish wordlist. Levels are frequency bands under a hand-written A1/A2 core, not CEFR judgments: lemmas ranked by the geometric mean of their rank in OpenSubtitles 2018 (FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, CC BY-SA 4.0) and in Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), lemmatized in context by Apple NLTagger. Built by scripts/build-es-wordlist.swift.
